name: com.lurcottlabs/intake
title: Lurcott Labs: request a quote
description: Electronics design for OEMs: your AI describes the job; the engineer who'll do the work quotes it.

tools.name: about_lurcott_labs
tools.description: What Lurcott Labs does, the jobs it typically takes on, and how quoting works. Read this first.

tools.name: submit_inquiry
tools.description: Start an inquiry: describe the electronics job in plain words (what it is, what it does, who uses it, where, how many, by when, as far as you know). Include your human's name and email: an engineer replies there. Returns an inquiry ID and the first follow-up question. Up to 12,000 characters; no attachments, no confidential documents, no other personal details. Write only what you know; the follow-up questions ask for the rest, and your human's answers count most.

email.description: Your human's email: the engineer replies there.

tools.name: intake_exchange
tools.description:
Answer the last follow-up question on an inquiry. Returns the next question, or status ready_for_review when the intake is complete.

source (required) says where the answer comes from: "inquiry" (it was in the job description), "human" (your human told you), "guess" (your own best guess) or "mixed" (say which part is which in the answer).

Please check these with your human rather than guessing, because they change the design and the quote most: where and in what conditions it will be used (temperature, water, chemicals, cold rooms); how it mounts and what it has to fit; what sets the deadline; quantities; certifications; who will build it; and other systems on site it must work with or replace. "I'll check with my human" or "don't know" are good answers.

tools.name: inquiry_status
tools.description: Where an inquiry stands: received, questions_open (the last question is repeated) or ready_for_review (with the facts still unconfirmed on the client side, if any).
